title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SpecialDayProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SpecialDayProfile. [COSEM] This class allows defining special dates. On such dates, a special switching behaviour overrides the normal one. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own DayProfile; inherits hasDaySchedule (documented on the DayProfile model and not repeated here).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SpecialDayProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasSpecialDayDate.description: Property. Dates at which a normal day is considered a special date (e.g. Christmas).
